lines.text: June Cleaver's pearls hid a shadow.
On Leave It to Beaver, June cooked in a dress and pearls.
Actress Barbara Billingsley had a hollow at the base of her neck.
The set's lights turned that hollow into a dark shadow on camera.
Lighting could not fix it, so the crew tried scarves and collars.
A pearl choker covered the hollow on camera.
She explained it in a Television Academy interview in 2000.
lines.say: She explained it in a Television Academy interview in two thousand.

lines.text: Heels came later, when her screen sons grew taller than she was.
Even Oprah Winfrey asked about the pearls and heels.
The show ran 234 episodes over six seasons, from 1957 to 1963.

post.caption: June Cleaver's pearls hid a shadow. On Leave It to Beaver, June cooked in a dress and pearls. Actress Barbara Billingsley had a hollow at the base of her neck. She explained it in a Television Academy interview in 2000. Heels came later, when her screen sons grew taller than she was. Even Oprah Winfrey asked about the pearls and heels.
